title: Chromatic Number of Grassmann Graphs and MRD codes
summary: In this paper we investigate the chromatic number of the Grassmann graphs and of their powers, denoted $J_q(n,m,t)$. In this graph, the vertices correspond to the $m$-dimensional subspaces in $\mathbb{F}_q^n$ and two vertices are adjacent if the corresponding subspaces intersect in a subspace of dimension at least $t$. By generalizing the lifting technique of Silva, Kötter and Kschischang, we use \emph{maximum rank distance (MRD)} codes to establish that $χ(J_q(n, m, t)) \leq (1 +o(1))n^{m-t}q^{(n-m)(m-t)})$ when $n \geq 2m$.
